hooks.name: neo-session-context
hooks.description: Loads the using-neo router and the project steering index when it exists.

action.command:
skill="$PWD/.kiro/skills/using-neo/SKILL.md"; if [ ! -f "$skill" ]; then skill="${KIRO_HOME:-$HOME/.kiro}/skills/using-neo/SKILL.md"; fi; if [ -f "$skill" ]; then printf '%s

' 'neo loaded. Route every task through the using-neo single entry point.'; cat "$skill"; index="$PWD/.kiro/steering/INDEX.md"; if [ -f "$index" ]; then printf '

%s

' 'Project steering is available. Read and follow .kiro/steering/INDEX.md now, including every file it marks with inclusion: always.'; cat "$index"; fi; else printf '%s
' 'neo: using-neo router not found. Skills may still be available individually.'; fi
